query: When did the Tranche 1 privacy reforms come into effect?

detail.text: Not everything in Tranche 1 commenced on that single date. The statutory tort for serious invasions of privacy (Schedule 2) was subject to commencement by Proclamation, defaulting to 11 June 2025 if not proclaimed earlier — meaning that provision's actual in-force date depends on whether an earlier Proclamation was issued, which the tracked record doesn't confirm one way or the other. The automated-decision-making disclosure requirement — new content obligations for APP privacy policies amending APP 1.3 and APP 1.4 — has a materially later commencement of 10 December 2026, still 17 months away from today's date.
detail.reason: The evidence states that the automated-decision-making disclosure requirements 'came into effect on 10 December 2024 (or shortly thereafter),' directly contradicting the claim that commencement is '10 December 2026, still 17 months away from today's date.'
